name: evaluation
description: Evaluation execution and analysis: run correctness/quality evaluations, interpret outputs, and store structured reports.
when_to_use: Running MCP tool evaluations, eval-guided model upgrades, capturing structured EvaluationReport with score, gaps, and stored path.
workflow_sequences: run_tool_evaluation(...) → manage_file(operation='read') to analyse → manage_file(operation='write') to store when gaps found
skill_pack(operation="execute", pack_name="evaluation") — runs run→analyse→store cycle automatically
troubleshooting_tips: Eval results are stored under .cortex/evals or cache; use get_structure_info for paths.
store phase is skipped when analyse.passed is True (no gaps found).
If run_tool_evaluation is not in registry, the workflow will fail at the run phase.
